label: analyst for
definition: Person 1 is or was an analyst for organization 2.
scope_notes: Explicit analyst titles and following/tracking an industry for the employer qualify. Economist, strategist or specialist without analyst evidence may require role-scope review; president/director/professor/lawyer alone do not establish this role.

facts.reason: Goldman is explicitly an analyst for/at/with Merrill Lynch.
Feldman is president of the United Federation of Teachers, including an elected-president path; no analyst role is expressed.
Kunstler is explicitly an analyst with, at and for J. P. Morgan.
Fine is explicitly an analyst at/for/with Chase Asset Management.
Healy is explicitly an analyst at/with/for Burnham Securities.
